# Codex Transfer by VI-IT

> Codex Transfer by VI-IT is a free portable Windows utility for backing up and migrating a local OpenAI Codex workspace to a new PC.

The software can include the local Codex home, sessions, settings, state databases, file-based authentication data, skills, plugins, selected project folders, SSH keys and global Git configuration in one local `.codex` archive. During restore, supported references to the old Windows user profile are mapped to the new profile.

Backup contents remain local and are not transmitted to VI-IT. The application makes a public GitHub Releases metadata request at startup to check for newer versions. A password is optional but strongly recommended.

Codex Transfer does not guarantee migration of device-bound Windows credentials, browser sessions or cloud-managed ChatGPT account data. Reauthentication may be required.

## Product facts

- Product: Codex Transfer by VI-IT
- Version: 1.0.0
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Distribution: one self-contained portable EXE
- Price: free
- Languages: German and English, selected automatically from Windows display language
- Publisher: VI-IT
- Status: independent software, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI
